records.title: Campaign & Creative Manager, Live Events Ads Services

jd.text:
Amazon Advertising operates at the intersection of digital advertising and eCommerce, and offers advertisers a rich array of media solutions across Amazon’s mobile and desktop websites, proprietary devices including Kindle and Fire TV, and the Amazon Programmatic Demand Side Platform (DSP). We are looking for a highly motivated Campaign and Creative Manager (CCM) who is passionate about helping our advertisers make effective, analytically driven marketing decisions. Change the world as our advertiser’s “go-to” experts on Amazon Advertising’s policy, process, creative services and retail business.
Live Events at Amazon is the advertising business built around premium live sports and live events streamed on Prime Video. Rather than traditional on-demand placements, it delivers ads into live broadcasts - matches, games, episodes and tournaments - letting advertisers reach large, engaged, appointment-viewing crowds in the way linear TV historically has, but with digital targeting, interactivity, and measurement layered on top.
What will you be able to achieve in this team?
Become a knowledgeable partner on Amazon Advertising solutions
Develop never-been-done-before executions with advertisers and internal partners during the pre-sales stage
Establish and standardize creative and operational best practices with advertisers to drive creative performance and provide frustration-free campaign launches
Grow and broaden your skills as you work in an environment that thrives on creativity, experimentation, and product innovation
Key job responsibilities
Manage the planning and delivery of high quality advertiser engagements to educate advertisers on Amazon policies and creative best practices to positively impact campaign performance within the Live Events space
Project managing the execution of complex Live Event advertising campaigns with internal Design, AdOps, Sales, Quality Assurance and Account Management teams as well as external stakeholders
Manage the Ad Schedule creation for live events, closely working with production on break durations and content
Consulting with advertisers on creative strategy using historical advertiser and industry data
Manage the troubleshooting of sometimes complex issues surfaced during the campaign life-cycle
Dive deep on data to develop and manage process and product improvement projects with internal and external stakeholders to improve cross-vertical/cross-locale efficiency
A day in the life
You will earn trust and foster frustration-free advertiser experiences through seamless end to end management of campaigns, data-driven creative strategy recommendations and ongoing advertiser education, all aimed at helping advertisers grow their business on Amazon while upholding our end customers’ experience. You will work with our partners to deliver results that matter to our advertisers for long-term growth. CCMs provide efficient and accurate campaign management while identifying opportunities to continuously improve workflows and implement best practices. The role provides a fast-paced environment that offers team members continual opportunities to learn, be curious and develop their skills.
About the team
If you love sports, solving big-customer problems and have a passion for new technology in the media space, then this role is an amazing opportunity that lies at the intersection of your interests. With broadcast agreements around the world including the NFL’s Thursday Night Football in the US, NBA globally, UAEFA Champions League in the UK, Wimbledon in Germany and The French Open (Roland-Garros) in France, Amazon Prime Video is delivering the future of Live Sports for our Prime customers. Advertising is a crucial part of our success in Live Sports and at Amazon Advertising, we sit at the intersection of advertising and eCommerce. We are building a world-class live sports ad program that benefits our customers, advertisers and league partners with unique, never-been-done-before ad experiences.

Amazon's automotive business is looking for a Senior Program Manager within the Support Operations and Programs (SOAP) team to serve as the single-threaded owner for a regional market. This role sits at the intersection of Operations Program Management, Process Improvement, and International Operations, requiring someone who can drive operational excellence across a regional market while continuously raising the bar.
You will own end-to-end operations for your assigned market: implementing SOAP policies and processes, monitoring performance, diagnosing systemic issues through root cause analysis, and partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable solutions. You will serve as the SOAP connective tissue between regional and central teams, as well as external partners (dealers, third-party services, regulatory bodies), ensuring the customer experience meets Amazon's high bar.
You will evaluate what works across markets, what needs adaptation, and what must be purpose-built for the local regulatory and consumer landscape. You will also contribute to international expansion efforts, building repeatable frameworks and mechanisms that scale beyond a single geography. The ideal candidate is a systems-level thinker who leads with data, thrives in ambiguity, and has a track record of delivering cross-functional programs at scale.
Key job responsibilities
Operations Program Management
Implement, localize, and enforce operational policies and standard operating procedures for the international markets, partnering with Legal, Compliance, and Policy teams to ensure alignment with regional regulations.
Build and maintain telemetry that provides leadership clear visibility into regional performance. Track progress against goals, surface risks and opportunities early, and ensure data is accurate and actionable.
Monitor key performance indicators across the customer journey (pre-purchase, purchase, post-purchase, dealer operations) and take ownership of closing gaps when performance deviates from targets.
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Customer Service, Dealer Operations, Finance) to resolve dependencies, remove blockers, and keep teams moving together on shared priorities.
Process Improvement & Root Cause Analysis
Analyze customer contact, escalation, and concession patterns, customer effort signals, and resolution data to identify cross-cutting failure modes and improvement opportunities.
Drive continuous improvement through root cause analysis on systemic issues, partnering with regional and central teams to design and implement durable corrective actions rather than one-off fixes.
Define and own a measurement framework that connects operational quality to customer outcomes; use metrics to prioritize investments and quantify impact.
Leverage technology and automation (including AI-driven tooling) to increase operational efficiency, reduce manual intervention, and enable high-velocity decision making.
Launch & International Expansion
Support region launches by defining business requirements, success criteria, and rollback triggers in partnership with SOAP, Product, Engineering, and regional stakeholders.
Assess operational readiness to ensure SOAP is prepared for launch and sustained operations.
Build repeatable launch frameworks, playbooks, and mechanisms that can scale to other regions.
Communicate operational changes and launch milestones to senior leadership through clear, actionable narratives and structured program updates.
A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing operational dashboards to review order volumes, contact rates, and triaging overnight escalations. By mid-morning, you're leading a working session with product and engineering to turn an operational gap into a requirements doc. After lunch, you sync with a dealer partner on process questions ahead of a regional rollout. In the afternoon, you facilitate a cross-functional meeting with Customer Service, Legal, and Payments to unblock a financing workflow. You close the day drafting the weekly operations narrative for the business review.
About the team
The Support Operations and Programs (SOAP) team ensures every customer touchpoint across Amazon's automotive business runs smoothly. We own support operations, operational policy, process design, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement, partnering cross-functionally with tech and non-tech teams to deliver a reliable, high-quality customer experience at scale.

About the team
The Credit Risk team is part of Airwallex’s Second Line of Defence and helps the company grow responsibly as a global financial platform.
We work at the intersection of credit, FX, and counterparty risk, partnering closely with Product, Sales, Operations, Treasury, Finance, Engineering, Compliance, and Legal to enable commercial growth while protecting Airwallex from financial loss and excessive risk exposure. This is a team for analytical, commercially minded risk leaders who are energized by building scalable frameworks and practical controls across a fast-moving, multi-currency global network.
What you'll do
As Director, Credit Risk, you will lead Airwallex's global second-line oversight of credit, FX, and counterparty risk. You will set the risk guardrails that allow the business to grow safely across merchant acquiring, charge cards, FX, treasury, settlement, and banking-partner activities. Reporting to the Senior Director, Financial Risk, you will own the global framework, risk appetite, limits, governance, and portfolio oversight for these risk areas. You will provide independent challenge to first-line decisions and act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders across the business.
This role is based in London.
Responsibilities
Credit risk framework and risk appetite: Define, implement, and continuously enhance the global second-line credit risk framework, including policies, risk appetite thresholds, limits, escalation protocols, and governance standards across Airwallex’s products and legal entities.
Credit portfolio oversight: Oversee credit exposures across merchant acquiring, charge cards, B2B and commercial activities, FX pre-funding, treasury-related exposures, settlement flows, and other relevant products.
Underwriting and limit governance: Review and challenge first-line underwriting strategies, customer and merchant risk policies, credit assessments, limit-setting methodologies, and exception processes. Act as a senior escalation point for complex or high-value credit decisions.
FX risk oversight: Establish and monitor appropriate second-line guardrails for FX exposures arising from pre-funding, settlement, customer activity, treasury flows, and other multi-currency activities. Job Title
Operational Business Analyst
About your role:
Reporting to the Programme Director and/or Programme Manager, the role of Operational Readiness Business Analyst is to support client implementations, conversions and migration initiatives by assessing, documenting and coordinating the operational readiness activities required to enable a successful transition into go-live, warranty and business-as-usual.
Working closely with clients, internal Fiserv teams and third-party partners, the Operational Readiness Business Analyst helps ensure that operational processes, support models, controls, procedures, training needs and handover requirements are clearly understood, documented and aligned to the target-state solution and implementation plan.
The Operational Readiness Business Analyst is responsible for supporting readiness activities across the full project lifecycle, from initial impact assessment and readiness planning through implementation support, go-live preparation and transition to BAU. The role acts as a key link between business stakeholders, operations, service and support teams, implementation teams, product, technology and testing teams to help ensure that operational teams are prepared for change and able to support the target operating model effectively.
Within this context, the role requires a good understanding of issuing and card-processing environments, operational processes and the practical impacts of migrating from legacy platforms to modern target solutions.
What you will do:
Supporting the definition and coordination of the operational readiness approach in alignment with project and implementation objectives.
Assessing current-state and target-state operational processes to identify readiness impacts, gaps, dependencies and required changes.
Gathering, analysing and documenting operational readiness requirements across business, service, operations and support teams.
Supporting the identification of impacts to operating procedures, service models, controls, escalation paths, support processes and business continuity arrangements.
Producing and maintaining readiness documentation, including impact assessments, readiness trackers, process documentation, handover requirements and supporting artefacts.
Working closely with implementation, business analysis, product, technology, testing and operations teams to ensure that readiness activities are aligned to the broader programme plan.
Supporting the definition and tracking of readiness criteria for key milestones, go-live and transition to BAU.
Coordinating with stakeholders to ensure that process changes, support requirements, operational dependencies and handover activities are clearly understood and planned.
Supporting training needs assessment and readiness-related communications for impacted teams where required.
Identifying, analysing and resolving operational readiness queries raised by stakeholders, internal teams and third-party partners.
Supporting go-live preparation by ensuring that operational teams, processes and support arrangements are ready for transition.
Acting as a liaison between business, operations, service/support teams and project delivery teams throughout the readiness lifecycle.
Execution & Controls
Managing and maintaining operational readiness deliverables in accordance with established Fiserv governance, standards and project methodology.
Supporting the planning, prioritisation and tracking of operational readiness activities in line with project milestones, implementation phases and delivery timelines.
Ensuring that readiness requirements, dependencies, actions and open points are captured, tracked and progressed to closure.
Maintaining operational readiness trackers and supporting the assessment of readiness status across impacted teams and functions.
Working with stakeholders to validate readiness criteria, handover requirements and support arrangements prior to go-live.
Participating in governance meetings, working sessions and status reviews to provide updates on readiness progress, key issues, risks and unresolved dependencies.
Escalating readiness risks, gaps, blockers or delivery concerns to the appropriate stakeholders in a timely and structured manner.
Supporting implementation and testing activities where operational readiness input is required, including business process validation and handover readiness.
Supporting warranty and BAU transition planning by ensuring that support teams, processes, documentation and responsibilities are clearly defined and agreed.
Maintaining clear and consistent communication with clients, internal teams and third parties on operational impacts, readiness actions and transition requirements.
Closeout & Transition
Confirming that operational readiness requirements and agreed handover activities have been completed and transitioned appropriately into go-live, warranty and BAU support processes.
Supporting the completion and archiving of readiness documentation, including process updates, handover artefacts and supporting records.
Assisting with post-implementation reviews to assess readiness outcomes, operational issues and improvement opportunities.
Ensuring that outstanding readiness actions, process gaps or follow-up items are tracked through to closure or transitioned appropriately into warranty and BAU support processes.
Contributing to Lessons Learned activities where applicable.
Experience you’ll need to have:
Proven experience (minimum 5 years) in one or more of the following areas: Operational Readiness, Service Readiness, Business Process Change, Operations, Customer Servicing, Testing, Training, and BAU Handover within the Financial Services industry, in the Cards and Payments sector; experience in card and/or payment processing environments is preferred.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with professional proficiency in both English and Italian.
Good understanding of implementation lifecycles, go-live readiness, handover processes and transition to BAU.
Working knowledge of issuing, card-processing and payments operations, with an understanding of how operational requirements translate into service and support.
Experience that would be great to have:
Business Analysis, Change Management or Project Delivery certification preferred.
Experience supporting migrations from legacy platforms to modern processing platforms.
Experience working on multi-country programmes and complex client delivery initiatives.
Exposure to operational change, support model design or business readiness activities within issuing or payments environments preferred.
Salary starting at €52,470 - negotiable depending on experience

Job Title
Solution Lead
About your role:
The Solution Lead – Merchant Solutions is responsible for defining, designing, and leading the delivery of end-to-end merchant acquiring and payment solutions for banks, fintechs, payment service providers, and merchants. The role acts as the primary solution authority across client engagements, providing strategic and functional leadership to ensure successful implementation of acquiring platforms, payment gateways, switching, settlement, and value-added services.
The Solution Lead serves as the key liaison between clients, business stakeholders, product teams, architects, and delivery organizations, ensuring that business objectives are translated into scalable, secure, and commercially viable payment solutions.
What you’ll do
Own the end-to-end merchant acquiring solution across the project lifecycle.
Lead solution architecture discussions and define target-state operating models.
Evaluate client requirements and align them with platform capabilities and product roadmaps.
Design scalable solutions covering: Merchant Acquiring, Payment Gateways, Authorization & Switching, Scheme Clearing & Settlement, Merchant Pricing & Billing, Reconciliation & Reporting, Fraud Management, Digital Commerce & Value-Added Services
Ensure solution compliance with card scheme, regulatory, security, and operational requirements.
Act as trusted advisor for strategic client engagements. Lead client workshops, solution reviews, and executive presentations.
Provide consultative guidance on acquiring transformation, modernization, migration, and market expansion initiatives.
Present solution options, risks, assumptions, and recommendations to client leadership teams.
Experience you’ll need to have:
Extensive SME Functional knowledge in Merchant Acquiring Solutions covering payment gateway, authorization switches, scheme clearing & settlements, merchant pricing, interchange and scheme fees, financial reconciliations.
Analytical skills and understanding industry metrics and trends.
10+ years of experience in Payments, Banking Technology, or Merchant Acquiring.
5+ years in Solution Architecture, Solution Consulting, or Solution Leadership roles.
Demonstrated experience delivering complex acquiring or payment transformation programs.
Strong customer-facing consulting experience with financial institutions or payment providers.
Salary starting at €69,390 - negotiable depending on experience

Who are we?
Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.
People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.
The role
Howden is moving from deploying AI tools to embedding AI into how the business actually works. The Group AI Function has a clear mandate to drive that shift, and the next phase demands stronger technical governance, sharper architecture thinking, and closer oversight of what’s being built across the organisation.
The AI Technical Lead is the technical authority inside the function. The role owns architecture governance, leads the assessment of AI tools and vendors, and provides technical oversight across AI initiatives running inside Howden and with external delivery partners. When engineering work is happening — whether done internally or by third parties — this role ensures it’s done to the right standard and that Howden retains genuine ownership of the output.
This is an individual contributor role. It sits at the centre of a programme that touches every part of the Group, with direct access to senior stakeholders and real influence over how our AI capability develops.
Key responsibilities
Architecture governance
Own the technical governance process for AI tools and platforms across the Group. Lead Architecture Review Board submissions, produce architecture and security design documentation, and work alongside Enterprise Architecture as the AI function’s technical representative. The goal is coherent, well-governed AI infrastructure — not a patchwork of unconnected tools.
Vendor and tooling assessment
Lead the technical evaluation of inbound AI vendors and tools. Build a repeatable assessment framework that gives the Head of AI a clear, evidence-based view of what to adopt, what to decline, and where to build instead. Ensure that tooling decisions are grounded in architecture fit, security, data governance, and commercial sense — not just functionality.
Oversight of AI delivery
AI initiatives are running across multiple divisions, and external partners are actively involved in delivery. This role provides the technical oversight that ensures quality, protects Howden’s IP, and prevents the organisation from becoming dependent on third parties for capability it should own internally. This isn’t a hands-off review role — it requires enough depth to challenge, guide, and take accountability for outcomes.
Technical enablement
Set and maintain technical standards for how AI is built across the business — covering areas like agent development, knowledge retrieval, prompt engineering, and evaluation. Support colleagues and divisional AI leads who are building or deploying AI, and translate technical constraints into practical guidance that people can actually use.
Technical partnership to the Head of AI
Provide the technical grounding that allows the Head of AI to make well-informed decisions quickly. This means flagging risks, pressure-testing proposals, and being a genuine thought partner — not just an executor. The function is small and the relationship needs to work closely.
Background and experience
Essential
Desirable
Hands-on experience with large language models, retrieval systems, and agent frameworks
Exposure to insurance or another regulated industry
Cloud-native AI architecture experience
Experience with enterprise AI platform governance
Track record writing architecture or security design documentation
Familiarity with AI evaluation and quality assurance approaches
Ability to assess AI vendors and tooling rigorously and independently
Experience overseeing third-party AI delivery
Strong communication — equally comfortable with engineers and senior leaders
Previous work in an architecture review or governance context
Intellectually curious, low-ego, and comfortable moving fast in ambiguous conditions
Experience in a small, high-output team
What good looks like
Over the first year, success in this role means:
Architecture governance runs smoothly — new tools are assessed, documented, and reviewed without creating bottlenecks or risk
A repeatable vendor assessment process is in place and being used consistently
Technical oversight of external delivery partners is formalised and effective
AI standards and best practices are being adopted across the business, not just documented
Howden is demonstrably building internal AI capability rather than outsourcing it
The Head of AI has a technical partner who makes decision-making faster and better
Working in the Group AI Function
The Group AI Function is deliberately small. We work directly with senior stakeholders, operate across the whole Group, and move between strategy and execution without much ceremony. The Head of AI reports to the Group CTO and works closely with divisional leadership. The pace is real and the problems are interesting.
The culture values getting things right over looking right. Direct, honest, curious — and not precious about hierarchy or process for its own sake. The role carries real scope from day one and genuine influence over how the function and the broader AI capability develops.

A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:
Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new
We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges
We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond

Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).
Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.
Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.
AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.
Join us as a Staff Data Analyst - Ops & Compliance to build the analytics foundations that power Qonto's compliance execution. You'll own a brand-new scope — monitoring KYC/KYB funnels, remediation campaigns, and financial exposure — working cross-functionally with Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, and Internal Control, under the guidance of Alma, our Lead Data Analyst.
👩‍💻🧑‍💻 As a Data Analyst at Qonto, you will
Build compliance process monitoring from scratch: You'll build and own the data infrastructure that powers compliance monitoring at Qonto — from onboarding funnel analytics to remediation financial exposure — giving product, operations and compliance teams the self-service tools they need to make decisions without waiting on a data request.
Model and transform data with dbt: With the collaboration of Analytics Engineer Team, you'll build end-to-end transformation pipelines from source to consumption layer, keeping metric definitions clean and trusted by non-technical stakeholders.
Turn regulatory questions into self-service assets: You'll partner with Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, and Internal Control to scope and ship analytical tools
Own the KYC/KYB funnel analytics end-to-end: You'll deliver insights from CS initiation through KYB validation — refusal reasons, document gaps, lead-time distributions — so teams can act on friction fast.
Track remediation campaigns and financial exposure: You'll measure MRR secured, at risk, or lost across active campaigns, with peak intensity in Q4 (budget season) and May–June (reforecast).
🤔 What you can expect
A greenfield, strategically critical scope: Qonto is under close regulatory scrutiny — you'll build analytics foundations that matter company-wide, not just for your team.
Senior, cross-functional exposure from day one: Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, Internal Control — few DA roles give you this breadth of senior stakeholder access at this level.
Real ownership in the Modern Data Stack: You'll build in Omni and dbt with a high degree of autonomy — no legacy to untangle, just foundations to create.
A team where AI is a first-class tool: Unlimited access to AI tools (Claude, Cursor, and more) to evolve how you work, not just output more.
➡️ Your future manager
Your manager will be Alma, our Lead Data Analyst for Ops & Finance. Alma knows exactly what it takes to build an analytics function that actually changes decisions, and she'll push you to do the same.
Alma reports to Erwan, Director of Business Analytics who oversees the entire Analytics function and ensures alignment across teams.
🏅 About You
Compliance or regulated environment experience: You've worked analytically on KYC/KYB, AML, remediation, or similar regulatory/operational processes — and you know how to get credible with those stakeholders fast.
Self-service product mindset: You've designed dashboards and models for end-users to explore autonomously, adapting the same dataset from ops-level (daily SLA tracking) to exec-level (budget readouts).
Cross-functional stakeholder management: You've juggled competing analytical priorities across multiple teams — and you know how to scope clearly, push back when needed, and drive adoption.
Strong SQL and data modelling skills: You've built end-to-end transformation pipelines, enforced data quality, and made non-technical stakeholders trust your numbers.
AI-native workflow: You actively use AI tools to accelerate your analytics work — from data modelling to stakeholder communication — and you're genuinely curious about going further.
Language: Fluent in English.

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
For everyone, everywhere.
More about our mission and what we offer .
Wise Business has historically grown through self-serve and product-led channels. We’re now building a dedicated velocity sales team to help larger businesses discover, adopt, and fully activate on Wise for their international payment and banking needs. We’re looking for an experienced Salesforce & GTM Systems Specialist, who is passionate about the Wise mission – money without borders – to join our GTM Systems team. This is a key role in driving performance by collaborating with commercial leadership, revenue operations, analytics, marketing and other cross-function teams to ensure the execution of our Go-To-Market strategies. This will be a high impact and visibility role. The role is based in our London office, but you will also work closely with the global Wise Business Sales teams.
Since 2011, we’ve had a clear mission: money without borders. Built by and for people who live global lives, we’re the fairest, easiest way to manage your money across borders.
Over 10 million active personal and 700,000 business customers now use Wise to move more than £25 billion across borders each quarter, and saved £1.5 billion compared to banks over the past year.
A bit about the role:
In this role you will be responsible for designing and building the systems that power the Wise Business go-to-market engine. You will utilise your Salesforce expertise alongside other key tools across marketing, enrichment and engagement to build and optimize processes for our commercial teams for this high velocity business. You will work cross functionally to partner with Sales Leadership, Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement & Marketing to translate their needs into scalable systems and workflows that accelerate and streamline a fast growing area of the business. You will lead tooling for the newly setup Wise Business Sales teams and should be excited about the 0-1 build phase. You must be self-driven, motivated and comfortable with ambiguity. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Salesforce and systems that goes beyond administration within a high growth environment, preferably in the fintech space.
Your mission:

Description
This position can be based from any EMEA Corporate Location or current site (pending site lead, PXT and Hiring manager approval).
As an Incident Response Manager within Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS) Security Operations Group (SOG), you will serve as the primary crisis response coordinator for high and moderate severity incidents (SEV1, SEV2 and SEV3) impacting Amazon's people, operations, assets, and brand across globally. You will independently own the end-to-end lifecycle of critical incidents from initial notification and triage though immediate mitigation, stakeholder coordination, and post-incident review. Reporting to the Sr. Manager – Operations Incident Management, you will operate within established GSOC and SOG protocols, lead Incident Management Teams (IMTs) through complex crisis events, and drive continuous improvement of response frameworks across one of Amazon's most dynamic operating environments.
Key job responsibilities
Lead end-to-end coordination of high severity incidents (SEV1/SEV2), managing the full lifecycle from initial notification through mitigation, stabilization, and closure
Own 24/7/365 on-call rotation, responding to threats and incidents within the CTI Matrix per SOG escalation procedures, including Slack channel activation and senior leadership notification
Coordinate Immediate Mitigation calls with site-level Incident Commanders and IMTs, assigning action items to ensure life safety, operational continuity, and brand protection
Execute tactical response protocols including video lockdown, ESU/Off-Duty deployments, and OSINT/SOCMINT analysis within established timelines
Prepare site risk overviews and deliver incident summaries to WWOS senior leadership within 4 hours of incident onset
Manage Incident Room operations including real-time updates, dynamic action tracking, EMT notifications, and stakeholder conference calls
Lead After Action Reviews within 3 days of incident conclusion, driving corrective actions and mechanism implementation to prevent recurrence
Maintain and validate high severity protocols, the CTI Matrix, escalation workflows, and response timelines through continuous improvement
Partner with GSOC, Regional S&LP, Operations, WHS, and PXT to influence decision-making and ensure site-level IMT readiness per WWOS Critical Incident Response standards
A day in the life
As an Incident Response Manager, your day begins by reviewing active Incident Rooms, monitoring the GSOC threat landscape, and independently assessing emerging threats against the Category, Type, and Item (CTI) matrix to determine escalation requirements. You drive strategic and tactical work simultaneously, supporting Immediate Mitigation (IM) calls with site-level Incident Commanders and IMTs, and leading real-time response actions. Throughout the week, you engage senior stakeholders across WWOS, Ops, PXT, ER, WHS, and Ops Disruption leadership, supporting GSOC Conference Calls and guiding decision-making during critical incidents. You own On-Call rotation responsibilities, responding to emerging threats with direct mitigation support including coordinating ESU/Off-Duty deployments, conducting OSINT/SOCMINT analysis, and delivering initial incident summaries to WWOS senior leadership within established SLAs. When high severity events arise, you exercise independent judgment to create site-specific Slack channels, manage video lockdown tickets, prepare site risk overviews and hardening posture assessments, and lead After Action Reviews (AARs) within 3 days of incident conclusion.
About the team
The Operational Incident Response (OIR) team sits within the Security Operations Group (SOG) under Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS). The team provides 24/7/365 critical incident coordination across WWAS operations, serving as the central point for real-time response to life safety events, operational disruptions, natural disasters, workplace violence, and facility security threats. Working through the GSOC, the team brings together key stakeholders, manages Incident Rooms, and drives resolution from first notification through post-incident review.
OIR members are senior individual contributors who independently own the full incident lifecycle. They coordinate Immediate Mitigation calls with site-level Incident Commanders and IMTs, facilitate GSOC Conference Calls for SEV1 events, and deliver incident summaries to WWOS senior leadership. Key partnerships include GSOC, Regional S&LP, Operations leadership, Legal, and cross-functional business continuity stakeholders across highly diversified global environments.
The team operates as a service to the business, ensuring continuation of operations through risk oversight, contingency planning, and structured response. This role requires independent judgment under pressure, real-time coordination across multiple time zones, and the ability to influence senior leadership during unfolding events where life safety is at stake.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Risk Management, Business Administration, Security Management, or a related field
Experience applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses, or experience in building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making
Experience building cross-functional partnerships and influencing stakeholders across the organization to act without having a direct reporting relationship
Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
Experience prioritizing and handling multiple assignments at any given time while maintaining commitment to deadlines, or experience with end-to-end project management
Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders
Experience in a high-volume environment, such as a security operations center, event security, call center, or crisis management/emergency response center
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment, or experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects
Master's degree in risk management, Security, Business Administration, or related field
A security/risk management industry certification (ASIS CPP, CRMP, CBCP, or equivalent)
Advanced experience with risk, business continuity, and data management platforms (BSI, Audit Board, etc.)

Description
Amazon Key is building an infrastructure-agnostic access layer for the housing sector that overlays intelligent keyless access onto existing electrical systems for communal entrance without replacing what is already installed. For contractors and staff who work across multiple buildings and portfolios, it replaces fragmented keys, codes and sign-in processes with a single seamless UX on their phone. For property teams, it creates a centralized process, with tamper-proof audit trails that becomes the one system of record for every non-resident entry, every day. For delivery drivers, it grants secure, time-bound access to communal entrances so parcels arrive safely inside the building instead of being left exposed or bounced back as failed deliveries; no keys, fobs or resident buzz-in required. We have a proven product and now we need an engine: a repeatable, instrumented, signal-driven machine that finds the right accounts, reaches the right decision-makers with the right message at the right moment, and hands Sales a warm, qualified, prioritized queue every single day.
We are looking for a B2B Growth marketer to design, build, and own that engine. This is a founding, high-ownership role that sits at the intersection of Marketing, Sales, and Revenue Operations. You will treat go-to-market like software: define the signals that indicate a housing provider is ready to buy, build the enrichment and outbound workflows that act on those signals, wire them into the CRM, measure conversion at every stage.
You will be the technical architect of lead generation, outbound, and signal detection for Amazon Key across the.
This role is highly cross-functional.
Key job responsibilities
Design the signal layer. Define and codify the buying signals that indicate an housing provider is in-market. Build the pipelines that detect them continuously.
Build the lead-gen engine end-to-end. Own sourcing → enrichment → scoring → routing → sequencing → attribution as a versioned, monitored system. Turn target-account lists into instrumented outbound programs.
Automate enrichment and data quality: Build data extraction and scraping flows from scratch. Stand up custom web-scraping and data-extraction pipelines where no clean source exists, feeding them into enrichment so target lists are built, not bought.
Generate account-specific outreach at scale. Build AI-assisted systems that produce personalized, on-message outreach for named accounts and multi-channel cadences with strong deliverability hygiene.
Instrument and report conversion. Define the funnel metrics (reply rate, meeting rate, pilot rate, stage conversion, time-to-money) and build the dashboards that feed conversion heartbeat.
Integrate the GTM stack.
Run experiments like an engineer. Ship, measure, iterate, and deprecate.
Read the commercial picture, not just the tech. You understand how a housing deal actually gets won, where demand comes from, how a prospect moves from first touch to signature, and which numbers predict revenue. That lets you decide what to build and what to drop based on impact on the funnel, so the engine is judged by deals closed, not workflows shipped.
Run your own show end to end. Give you a problem and a goal, not a spec, and you'll scope it, build a first version, put it in front of users, and keep refining until it holds up in production. You chase down what's broken yourself, close your own knowledge gaps, and carry a problem all the way to a working result rather than handing it off half-solved.
A day in the life
The applicable collective agreement for this role is CBA for employees of Telecommunication Sector. The position is classified at level 7 or above, depending on the candidate's skills, competences and experience.
About the team
The Amazon Key team sits within the Amazon Devices team alongside Ring and other Home Security teams. Key is a uniquely cross-functional team within Amazon, and often serves as the connective tissue between Smart Home/Devices, Logistics, Operations, and Retail/Shopping. We are the bridge between device management and physical services, and our team indexes highly on ownership and collaboration. We have lots of stakeholders, and we have relentlessly high standards for our high-visibility programs.

Experience in in a GTM Engineering, Revenue Operations, Growth Engineering, Marketing Operations, or Sales Engineering role with hands-on system-building ownership.
Demonstrated experience building automated lead-generation or outbound systems end-to-end (sourcing, enrichment, scoring, routing, sequencing, attribution).
Lead generation and enrichment: proven experience sourcing target accounts and contacts (including custom data extraction and web scraping) and enriching them with firmographic, technographic, and intent data to produce sales-ready, prioritized pipeline.
CRM integration and funnel management: proven experience integrating automated flows and data inputs into a CRM and managing the commercial funnel end-to-end, including lifecycle stages, handoffs, and reporting reliable enough to forecast from.
Expert-level CRM proficiency (Salesforce or HubSpot) at an administrator level, including objects, workflows, lifecycle logic, and reporting.
Hands-on experience with GTM automation and enrichment tooling (e.g., Clay, n8n/workflow automation, enrichment and intent-data APIs) and with multi-channel outbound (email + LinkedIn) including deliverability best practices.
Working proficiency with SQL and with integrating tools via APIs.

Senior Brand Partnerships Manager - 12 month Fixed Term Contract, Brand Partnerships - Prime Video Advertising, EU
Job ID: 10568523 | Amazon Digital UK Limited
Apply now
Description
12 month Fixed Term Contract (Maternity Cover)
This is a senior, high-visibility role owning our most sophisticated brand partnerships end-to-end. You will lead Tier 1 custom executions — the bespoke, IP-led integrations that represent the pinnacle of what we offer advertisers — taking them from concept through creative development, cross-functional alignment and delivery. You will also run our custom-integration think tank: the engine that invents, pressure-tests and scales new partnership formats. You will be the connective tissue between commercial ambition and creative execution, and a trusted senior partner to teams across PVI Marketing, Amazon Ads, Studios and Brand Innovation Lab.
Key job responsibilities
Tier 1 custom executions
Own Tier 1 brand partnerships and custom executions end-to-end — from opportunity framing and creative concept through development, production alignment and delivery.
Lead bespoke, IP-led integrations across EU titles (e.g. custom ad production, co-branded content, product placement and licensing tie-ins), ensuring each is on-brief, on-brand and delivered to a high creative standard.
Act as the senior day-to-day owner for flagship partnerships, coordinating advertisers, agencies, production partners and internal teams to keep complex, multi-workstream deals on track.
Manage approvals and creative sign-off for custom assets (e.g. tagged tune-ins, end cards, taglines), securing the right internal and legal clearances.
Custom-integration think tank
Run the custom-integration think tank — identifying, developing and pressure-testing new partnership formats that extend our offering beyond standard sponsorship.
Champion innovation and creative ambition while balancing commercial viability, operational feasibility and customer experience.
Bring market and competitive insight to shape the forward roadmap of custom formats for future slates.
Cross-functional leadership
Partner senior stakeholders across PVI Marketing, Amazon Ads (VSS, Go-to-Market, BIL) and Amazon MGM Studios to align on title selection, creative direction and ways of working.
Lead co-creation models across PVA, BIL and PVI Marketing, defining a shared north-star vision per partnership and clear ownership through development and production.
Author operating-model and process documentation, and drive cross-functional forums (title alignment meetings, programme reviews) that keep partners aligned.
Influence without authority across a complex, matrixed organisation, resolving trade-offs between creative, commercial and operational priorities.
Commercial & operating model
Structure commercially viable custom opportunities and packages, working with Finance, Business Affairs and Legal on terms, compliance and contracting.
Track performance and advertiser voice-of-customer, using insight to improve conversion, deal size and repeatability.
About the team
Prime Video Advertising’s Brand Partnerships team turns Prime Video’s world-class IP into premium, custom partnerships for the world’s biggest advertisers. Across EU and LATCANZ, we go beyond standard sponsorship to build bespoke, high-craft integrations — connecting brands to our titles through custom creative, product placement, licensing and multi-market campaigns. We work at the intersection of PVI Marketing, Amazon Ads, Amazon MGM Studios and the Brand Innovation Lab (BIL) to deliver partnerships that are commercially significant and creatively excellent, while protecting the customer experience and the integrity of our content.
Basic Qualifications
Experience in developing, negotiating and executing business agreements
Experience in a professional field or military
Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience working with Core Cloud Technology Services, including, but not limited to Compute, Edge, Hybrid, Security, and/or Networking
Experience working with Business Application Technologies, including, but not limited to End User Compute (EUC), Supply Chain, Contact Center as a Service, Consumer Data Applications, Encrypted Communications, and/or Communication Developer Services
Experience solving problems with technology in the Healthcare/Life Sciences Industry
Experience solving problems with technology in the Media & Entertainment Industry
Experience solving problems with technology in the Global Financial Services Industry
Experience solving problems with technology in the Telecommunications industry
Experience solving problems with technology in the Automotive & Manufacturing industries
Experience solving problems with technology in the Energy & Utilities industries
Experience in Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting
Experience working with Advanced Compute technologies including, but not limited to: Accelerated Compute, High Performance Compute, Visual/Spatial Compute, and/or IoT.
Experience working with Enterprise Application Modernization and Migration technologies, including, but not limited to, Mainframe, Serverless, Containers, or Cloud Operations
Experience working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage
Preferred Qualifications
Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations
Experience identifying, negotiating, and executing complex legal agreements

Construction Safety Manager, International Construction Safety
Job ID: 10568647 | Amazon UK Services Ltd.
Apply now
Description
At Amazon, safety is our top priority. We are looking for a WHS Construction Manager to drive health and safety across our construction projects. In this role you ensure our construction sites and vendors meet Amazon's safety standards and local regulations, partnering with contractors and project teams to embed safe working from design through delivery. You'll be the safety point of contact for construction activity in your area, keeping the people who build our sites safe.
Key job responsibilities
Ensure construction projects and vendors comply with Amazon safety standards and local construction regulations.
Conduct construction site safety inspections and review vendor safety documentation.
Partner with project teams and contractors to embed safe working from design through delivery.
Track construction safety performance and drive closure of identified gaps.
Support the wider WHS team in maintaining construction safety standards across projects.
A day in the life
You spend your time between construction sites and project teams, checking that contractors are working safely and in line with Amazon standards and local construction regulations. You carry out site inspections, review vendor safety documentation, and coach project and contractor teams on safe practices. You track safety performance across your projects, flag risks early, and work with vendors to close gaps. One day you're on a live construction site, the next you're reviewing safety plans for an upcoming build.
About the team
The Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) team plays a crucial role in keeping our people mentally and physically well at work. Our team works with managers, associates and local governments across our sites, ensuring compliance with Amazon's policies and legal regulations, and guaranteeing the safety of our work environments. The team offers a variety of opportunities, from Safety Technicians to Programme Managers. Regardless of your role, you'll contribute to the development and implementation of the safety strategy across the entire network.
Basic Qualifications
Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
A Bachelor's degree, or equivalent level of qualification in-line with the European Qualifications Framework (EQF), in the Construction, Civil/Structural Engineering, Occupational Safety field.
Practical understanding and application of WHS risk assessment and safety standards.
Experience managing health and safety within construction environments.
Working knowledge of construction safety regulations and vendor/contractor safety management.
Preferred Qualifications
Preferred qualifications are not required to apply for a position at Amazon. If you have all the basic qualifications above, we'd love to hear from you.
Experience with Lean, 5S or Kaizen methodologies and continuous improvement.
Experience using data and metrics to identify gaps and drive improvements.
NEBOSH General Certificate (or equivalent safety certification).
Experience with digital safety management systems.

Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey.
We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.
Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other.
Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or @contentsquare-ext.com domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.
Shape how our People function operates at scale.
We’re looking for a Global People Operations & Workday Governance Lead to sit at the intersection of People, Technology, Data and Transformation.
You’ll play a key role in building a scalable, secure and data-driven People function — owning global governance, driving Workday strategy, leading cross-functional cycles and helping us unlock the potential of automation and AI.
What you’ll do
🌍 Global People Governance
Own and drive alignment across global People processes, working closely with People Business Process Owners and senior People leadership.
Act as a key escalation point for complex Workday, People Operations and People Data matters.
Partner with Audit, Legal and Compliance to ensure strong controls, segregation of duties and secure access to People data.
⚙️ Workday, Automation & Transformation
Act as a strategic Business Process Owner and key partner to our Workday Product Owner and ISD.
Translate People needs into technical requirements and help shape the Workday roadmap and backlog.
Identify opportunities to simplify, automate and improve People processes, including through AI and emerging technologies.
Partner with Transformation to turn these opportunities into scalable solutions.
🧬 People Data & Analytics
Own global governance and integrity of People data, ensuring it is clean, consistent, secure and ready for advanced analytics and AI.
Partner with the business to develop dashboards, reporting and data solutions that enable better decision-making.
Oversee data access requests and ensure sensitive People data is appropriately protected.
🔄 Cross-functional Delivery
Lead major People cycles such as performance and compensation reviews, coordinating delivery across multiple People functions.
Drive change management, communication, documentation and training to ensure successful adoption of new Workday processes.
What we’re looking for
You’ll combine strategic thinking with strong operational and Workday expertise. You’ll ideally bring:
Experience in People Operations, HRIS, Workday, People Technology or a related field.
Strong understanding of global People processes, data and governance.
Experience managing complex, cross-functional projects and stakeholders.
The ability to translate business needs into scalable technology solutions.
A strong interest in automation, AI and the future of People Technology.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across functions and at senior level.
Why this role?
This isn’t just about keeping People processes running. It’s about designing how they should work in the future.
You’ll have the opportunity to shape our global People operating model, influence our Workday roadmap, strengthen our data foundations and help build a smarter, more automated People function.

About the job
The Professional Services team helps Contentsquare customers turn digital experience data into measurable business outcomes. As a Senior Strategic Consultant, you will be a senior, client-facing consultant responsible for delivering strategic, analytical, and enablement services to enterprise customers. You will combine consulting expertise, project management, digital analytics knowledge, and Contentsquare expertise to help customers understand their digital experience, prioritize opportunities, and take action.
You will work across two types of engagements:
One-off consulting missions, where you lead and deliver a defined project (analysis, workshop, training..)
Managed-services engagements, where you act as the delivery owner and project manager for an ongoing customer relationship. You will manage the service roadmap, coordinate contributors, maintain delivery momentum, and proactively ensure that the customer receives value from the available services.
You will operate as a trusted advisor to customer teams, including operational stakeholders, analytics teams, technical teams, and senior or economic buyers. You will work closely with Customer Success Manager and Sales but also all your Professional Services colleagues such as Data Analysts, UX Design Consultants, Implementation Managers, Training Consultants..
This role is ideal for someone who combines the structure and client leadership of a senior consultant with the curiosity and practical fluency of a digital analytics power user.
If you are not located in the offer’s specified location, the role is open to fully remote work within the country mentioned in the job posting.
What you’ll do
Own the delivery of strategic consulting and analytics engagements from discovery through completion.
Act as the primary operational point of contact for the services being delivered to the customer.
Define project objectives, scope, milestones, working methods, deliverables, and success criteria.
Build and manage delivery plans, priorities, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations.
Lead managed-services engagements as the delivery owner and project manager.
Maintain a proactive service roadmap and identify the right missions, workshops, analyses, training sessions, and enablement activities for each customer.
Coordinate the work of Data Analysts, UX Design Consultants, Implementation Managers, Training Consultants, and other specialists when required.
Escalate delivery risks, scope issues, capacity constraints, or customer blockers in a timely manner.
Ensure that customers receive measurable value from their Professional Services engagement.
Apply digital analytics and Contentsquare expertise
Analyze digital experience data and translate findings into clear business insights and actionable recommendations.
Prepare and deliver analyses, executive readouts, workshops, training sessions, and working sessions with customer teams.
Help customers define use cases, measurement approaches, prioritization frameworks, and roadmaps.
Assess data collection, tagging plans, data quality, measurement frameworks, and the conditions required for reliable analysis.
Use Contentsquare and other digital analytics tools to investigate customer questions and support evidence-based decisions.
Understand how digital analytics data can connect with broader customer data ecosystems, including business intelligence tools, data warehouses, data lakes, APIs, and activation platforms.
You are not expected to be a specialist Data Analyst or Data Architect, but you should be comfortable working with data and explaining analytical findings to both business and technical stakeholders.
Partner with customers and internal teams
Facilitate discussions with operational teams, analytics teams, technical stakeholders, senior leaders, and economic buyers.
Work closely with the Customer Success Manager. The CSM owns the broader partnership, while you own the quality, coordination, and delivery of the services provided.
Collaborate across the broader Professional Services organization and contribute your expertise to team discussions, methods, and delivery standards.
Build trusted relationships with enterprise customers and become a reliable advisor on their digital experience and analytics priorities.
Communicate complex analytical or technical concepts clearly to audiences with different levels of expertise.
Identify risks and opportunities
Monitor customer adoption, engagement, delivery progress, and stakeholder participation.
Proactively identify risks such as declining adoption, missed milestones, unclear ownership, or limited use of the platform.
Surface relevant expansion or cross-sell opportunities to the Customer Success and Sales teams. This is not a quota-carrying sales role, but you are expected to recognize when additional Contentsquare capabilities or services could address a customer need.
Identify opportunities to improve customer processes, measurement practices, data flows, or use of digital analytics.
Improve how we work
Contribute to reusable consulting methods, frameworks, templates, and points of view.
Use artificial intelligence responsibly to improve preparation, analysis, delivery quality, and internal processes.
Stay current with developments in digital analytics, artificial intelligence, data ecosystems, and customer experience measurement.
Share knowledge with other consultants and help strengthen the capabilities of the wider Professional Services team.
What you’ll need to succeed
Approximately 5 to 6 years of experience in management consulting, strategic consulting, digital consulting, professional services, or a similar customer-facing advisory environment.
Experience working with large enterprise customers and navigating complex stakeholder environments.
Demonstrated experience managing projects or workstreams from discovery through delivery.
Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills, including the ability to lead workshops and executive discussions.
Structured thinking and strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to frame ambiguous customer challenges clearly.
Practical experience with digital analytics, business intelligence, conversion optimization, customer experience analytics, or related data products.
Familiarity with digital analytics platforms such as Google Analytics or Adobe Analytics. Experience with Contentsquare is highly valuable.
Understanding of tagging plans, data collection, data quality, measurement frameworks, data structures, and the limitations that can affect analytical outcomes.
Ability to interpret data, develop an analysis, and communicate the implications and recommendations clearly.
Ability to work effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.
Strong project management skills, including planning, prioritization, risk management, stakeholder coordination, and escalation.
Ability to work independently across a changing mix of one-off missions and recurring managed-services engagements.
Comfortable collaborating with Customer Success, Sales, Data Analysts, UX Design Consultants, Implementation Managers, and other specialist teams.
Practical curiosity about artificial intelligence, data flows, data warehouses, data lakes, APIs, and modern digital analytics ecosystems.
Ability to use AI tools thoughtfully to improve your own work and customer delivery, while applying appropriate judgment and maintaining confidentiality.
Full professional fluency in French and English, including the ability to lead customer conversations, workshops, and presentations in French.
Availability to work with customers primarily during French or Central European business hours.
Willingness to travel occasionally for customer engagements, team meetings, and company events.

Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other.

About the role
The Deal Desk Analyst (12 month contract) will partner with the Sales, Finance, Legal, and Operations teams to manage the end-to-end deal process for our Sales teams. You will provide guidance on deal structure, pricing, discounting, quoting, and contract terms, ensuring opportunities align with company policies and commercial objectives.
You will act as a trusted advisor to Sales, helping teams navigate complex deals, secure the right approvals, and move efficiently from quote to close. You will also identify opportunities to improve processes, reduce cycle times, and strengthen the Deal Desk function.
What you’ll do:
Support the structuring and pricing of high-value and complex SaaS deals.
Review quotes, contracts, discounts, payment terms, and non-standard deal requests.
Ensure compliance with pricing guidelines, approval workflows, and internal policies.
Partner with Sales, Finance, Legal, and cross-functional teams to resolve deal-related questions and roadblocks.
Provide commercial guidance to Sales to support win rates and margin preservation.
Maintain accurate deal data across Salesforce and other relevant systems.
Track deal performance, approval timelines, and quote-to-close efficiency.
Identify and implement improvements to Deal Desk processes, systems, and documentation.
What you’ll bring:
Four or more years of experience in Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Pricing, or financial analysis.
Experience supporting complex enterprise B2B SaaS transactions.
Strong analytical, organisational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency with Salesforce and Excel or Google Sheets.
Excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
A collaborative, commercially minded approach with the confidence to advise and influence stakeholders.

The Product Director is a senior product leadership role within Experian’s Consumer Business (ECS), working in close partnership with the Chief Product & Commercial Officer to shape the direction of ECS's product portfolio in response to a rapidly evolving market in which AI is reshaping consumer behaviour and the competitive landscape. The role carries broad accountability across ECS's product portfolio, with the mandate expected to evolve as the business continues to diversify.
You will be responsible for setting and driving product strategy across this portfolio to achieve the region's revenue growth and customer strategy ambitions, ensuring our products evolve ahead of a fast-changing, AI-led market and that we win as consumer journeys move on- and off-property.
You will be a key leader within the ECS Product Community, fostering an environment where we launch market-leading, future-facing propositions at pace. You will incorporate internal and external perspectives, including regulatory engagement, to ensure we deliver a best-in-class experience for our customers.
You are required to lead in a global context, working closely with our teams in India and the UK to scale and improve ways of working across locations. There is an expectation that this role will be highly visible across both sites, to drive optimised ways of working and ultimately deliver business growth.
Core responsibilities
Shape ECS's overall product strategy in close partnership with the Chief Product & Commercial Officer, responding to AI-driven shifts in consumer behaviour and the competitive landscape
Define and lead product strategy and vision across ECS's core product portfolio, aligned to ECS and UK&I strategic goals
Own and deliver the product roadmap over a 12–24 month horizon, ensuring it is resourced and prioritised effectively
Shape and scale the next generation of value-led, goal-based propositions and the wider diversification of ECS's product set, evolving our products from stand-alone experiences into interconnected, signal-led customer journeys
Drive ECS's data and AI strategy as a source of competitive advantage across the product portfolio, including how we reach customers as consumer journeys extend on- and off-property
Harness consumer-permissioned data as a strategic advantage, turning real-time signals and alerts into personalised, converting moments across the portfolio
Lead the evolution of our Product Development operation across our global teams, driving improved collaboration
Deliver strategic plan revenue targets through product innovation, pricing and commercial model evolution, and portfolio diversification
Make prioritisation decisions that balance business needs, customer value, and regulatory requirements
Build and lead a high-performing product team, working closely with Engineering, Commercial, Analytics and AI/Data functions
Set OKRs across core product domains and collaborate across the wider ECS product portfolio to ensure consistency and alignment
What would success in the role look like?
A world-class product experience that delivers commercial growth and customer satisfaction
Successful launch and scale-up of new value-led, goal-based propositions that meet our changing customer needs
Demonstrable progress on data, AI and off-property strategy, with the product portfolio positioned to win as the market shifts toward AI-led and agentic consumer journeys
A highly engaged and motivated product team, across different geographies, delivering value consistently
Strong alignment across Product, Engineering, Commercial and Technology functions, with this role recognised as a key strategic partner to the CPCO
Clear evidence of innovation, market responsiveness and regulatory engagement
Continued growth of ECS's presence and leadership across our India and UK teams
Consumer-permissioned data demonstrably powering richer personalisation and higher-converting propositions across the portfolio
Skills & competencies needed:
Agile product development practice expert and technologist – deep understanding of how products work, the tech stacks that support them, and how AI is reshaping both
Exceptional communication skills – concise, clear and able to simplify complexity
Deeply client-focused – externally engaged product strategy approach with ability to influence UK&I regulatory bodies
Innovation evangelist – bold and ambitious propositions that drive growth and energise teams
Commercial strategist – drives growth through pricing, commercial models, and market assessments
Experienced P&L manager – highly numerate and comfortable managing complexity across a large, diversifying product portfolio
Stakeholder management and people leadership – able to operate as a trusted senior partner to the CPCO and influence senior stakeholders across a matrixed, geographically dispersed organisation (India and UK), inspiring followership within the team
Future-focused mindset – comfortable setting strategy amid ambiguity, and evolving the product portfolio as the market shifts toward AI-led and agentic consumer experiences

The chance to build a better future is right in front of you
Do Work That Matters - Il tuo ruolo e le tue responsabilità
Vuoi fare un lavoro che sia davvero significativo e di impatto? In KPMG avrai l’opportunità di aiutare i clienti, la società, le colleghe e i colleghi ad affrontare e risolvere le sfide più attuali e complesse. KPMG Advisory offre servizi di consulenza per affiancare le organizzazioni nella trasformazione dei processi, nella digitalizzazione e nell’adozione di soluzioni SAP a supporto del cambiamento.
Entrando a far parte del Team Enterprise Platforms , sarai coinvolta/o in progetti di implementazione e ottimizzazione di SAP Concur , con focus sui processi di Travel & Expense Management e sulla digitalizzazione delle note spese e delle trasferte aziendali.
Nello specifico, ti occuperai di:
Condurre workshop con stakeholder Business e IT per tradurre le esigenze di Travel & Expense Management in requisiti funzionali concreti.
Contribuire al disegno della soluzione to-be su SAP Concur, occupandoti di attività di configurazione e customizing.
Garantire, in collaborazione con team funzionali e tecnici, la corretta integrazione tra Concur , SAP ERP/S4HANA e le altre piattaforme aziendali coinvolte.
Curare la documentazione funzionale e seguire le fasi di test , go-live e hypercare, garantendo continuità anche nel post rilascio.
Affiancare gli utenti finali nelle fasi di adozione della soluzione.
Sarai coinvolta/o su progetti nazionali e internazionali, lavorando a stretto contatto con clienti e team multidisciplinari operanti in ambito Consumer & Industrial , con settori quali Retail, Food & Drink, Consumer Products, Industrial & Manufacturing e Automotive.
Come As You Are - Le tue competenze e caratteristiche
Questa opportunità è perfetta per te se:
Hai maturato esperienza su progetti SAP Concur e sei a tuo agio nel gestire in autonomia le fasi di analisi, configurazione e rilascio.
Hai esperienza in attività di analisi requisiti , configurazione , testing e supporto al go-live.
Possiedi una buona conoscenza dei processi Travel & Expense.
Hai familiarità con integrazioni verso sistemi SAP ERP o SAP S/4HANA.
Possiedi una buona padronanza della lingua inglese , preferibilmente con esperienze di studio e/o lavoro all'estero.
Sei disponibile a viaggiare sia a livello nazionale che internazionale per supportare i clienti nelle varie fasi progettuali.

Un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo , equo e che rispetta, incoraggia e valorizza le diversità.
Un contesto stimolante e dinamico che incentiva la creatività e il lavoro di squadra.
Modalità di lavoro ibrida , per promuovere un sano equilibrio tra vita lavorativa e personale.
Programmi di formazione e sviluppo avanzati per rimanere sempre aggiornati.
Mindset internazionale e progettualità innovative.
Iniziative incentrate sul benessere psicofisico .

Do you want to do work that is truly meaningful and impactful ? At KPMG, you will have the opportunity to help clients, communities, colleagues, and organizations address and solve today’s most complex challenges. KPMG Advisory provides consulting services to support organizations in process transformation , digitalization , and the adoption of SAP solutions to drive change.
By joining the Enterprise Platforms team, you will be involved in SAP Concur implementation and optimization projects, with a focus on Travel & Expense Management processes and the digitalization of expense reports and business travel management.
Specifically, you will be responsible for:
Gathering and analyzing business requirements through workshops and collaboration with Business and IT stakeholders.
Supporting the design of the to-be solution and performing SAP Concur configuration/customization activities.
Collaborating with functional and technical teams to ensure proper integration with SAP ERP/S/4HANA systems and other enterprise platforms.
Preparing functional documentation and supporting testing , go-live , and hypercare activities.
Supporting end users during project delivery and release phases.
You will work closely with Public Sector clients, contributing to innovative projects within central and local government, healthcare, education, and publicly owned organizations.

This opportunity is perfect for you if:
You have experience working on SAP Concur projects.
You have experience in requirements gathering , configuration , testing , and go-live support activities.
You have a solid understanding of Travel & Expense processes.
You are familiar with integrations involving SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA systems.
You possess strong interpersonal skills and a good command of the English language .

An inclusive and collaborative work environment that values diversity.

A hybrid working model designed to support work-life balance.
Advanced training and development programs to help you continuously grow.
An international mindset and involvement in innovative projects.
Initiatives focused on employees’ physical and mental well-being.

KPMG Advisory offers consulting services to companies to assist them in business model transformation, process improvement and digitisation, risk analysis and management, and support in extraordinary finance transactions.
Specifically, when you join the Transportation Team in Rome , you will focus on business reorganization in procurement and supply chain, innovation and reengineering, strategy and transformation: the goal is to improve the performance of production processes by adapting them to the changing needs of markets and customers.
You will have the opportunity to work together with leading Transportation clients on high-value strategic projects that have a crucial impact on their business.
Specifically, you will be tasked with:
Defining business strategies in the transportation industry

Feasibility studies and economic-financial analysis
Analysis of investment sustainability
Reorganization and reengineering of industrial processes

A master’s degree in Management or related field
Organizational and teamwork skills with attention to detail, including the ability to prioritize and manage various complex tasks and activities
Excellent knowledge of the MS Office package
Excellent knowledge of English , ideally with study and/or work experience abroad

An inclusive and equitable work environment that respects, encourages and values diversity
A challenging and dynamic environment that encourages creativity and teamwork
Hybrid work arrangements to promote a healthy work-life balance
Advanced training and development programmes to stay current
International mindset and innovative projects
Initiatives focused on mental and physical well-being
